project_info.theme: Fragrance note poster for MYSLF EDT Intense
project_info.color_palette: White, silver, black, smoky grey, warm wood brown

main_subject.detail: A clear MYSLF EDT Intense perfume bottle stands centered over a giant black-outlined YSL monogram on a white-silver background. Top text reads 'MYSLF EDT INTENSE' and 'CHẤT TÔI TINH TẾ ĐẦY CUỐN HÚT'. Ingredient callouts read 'DA THỊT LÔI CUỐN XẠ HƯƠNG', 'TƯƠI MÁT HOA CAM', and 'TRẦM ẤM GỖ & HỔ PHÁCH'. The set includes a translucent rock crystal, rough brown wood, and white orange blossoms.
main_subject.style: Luxury fragrance-note poster, modern monochrome ingredient composition, premium masculine storytelling

composition_elements.text: MYSLF EDT INTENSE, CHẤT TÔI TINH TẾ ĐẦY CUỐN HÚT, DA THỊT LÔI CUỐN XẠ HƯƠNG, TƯƠI MÁT HOA CAM, TRẦM ẤM GỖ & HỔ PHÁCH, NAM

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square fragrance-note poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a clear MYSLF EDT Intense bottle standing in front of a giant black-outlined YSL monogram on a bright white-silver background. Include the exact text 'MYSLF EDT INTENSE', 'CHẤT TÔI TINH TẾ ĐẦY CUỐN HÚT', 'DA THỊT LÔI CUỐN XẠ HƯƠNG', 'TƯƠI MÁT HOA CAM', 'TRẦM ẤM GỖ & HỔ PHÁCH', and 'NAM'. Add a translucent crystal on the left and rough wood with white orange blossoms on the right. Technical style: photoreal fragrance-note advertising composite, high-key luxury studio lighting, crisp glass edges and polished graphic contrast, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
